name: LLM-Inference-Bench
description: LLM-Inference-Bench is a comprehensive benchmarking suite for evaluating the hardware inference performance of large language models across diverse hardware platforms including GPUs and specialized AI accelerators. It covers models from LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen families with 7B and 70B parameters.
typical_sota_score: varies widely by model and hardware; no single typical SOTA (throughput/latency depend on model size and accelerator)
reputation: A specialized systems benchmark that is useful for hardware vendors and inference-engine comparisons, but it is not a broadly adopted general ML benchmark.
notes: Benchmarks inference performance on various hardware platforms and models; includes an interactive dashboard for configuration.
